_readme: Copy this to nodes.json and edit it. nodes.json is gitignored because it
contains your SSID, password and server hostname -- it is not as secret
as the PSKs in secrets/keys.json, but it is not public either.
Anything under 'defaults' applies to every node; anything inside a node
entry overrides it. Only node_id is mandatory per node.
The 'allowlist' is the list of the OTHER nodes' STA MAC addresses. That
is what lets a node tell a peer's broadcast sounding (the primary
signal) apart from a neighbour's microwave-adjacent laptop (garnish),
and it is what the two separate bandwidth budgets key off. You will not
know the MACs until each board has been booted once -- csi-hello and the
main firmware both print 'STA MAC' on startup. Provision once with an
empty allowlist, collect the MACs, then re-provision.
